theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Real Estate (+1.86%) and Health Care (+1.62%) led the market today, while Communication Svcs (-1.51%) and Energy (-0.28%) brought up the rear. That split lines up with a rotation out of growth: growth-oriented sectors averaged +0.01% versus +1.01% for defensives and +0.74% for value and cyclicals, suggesting money moved from high-multiple names into steadier, cash-generative businesses. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.59%, Dow +0.83%, Nasdaq +0.64% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.46%. The VIX fell 3.76% to 14.84, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.43% to $4,220.30, crude oil was little changed at $91.66, and bitcoin gained 0.11% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
